archive.meaning: Concatenate strictly in index order; verify every part and combined SHA256 before extracting. No original waveform samples removed.

capture_transport.method: Memory-mapped full binary raw; every original vector retained; no interpolation/decimation

clock_diagnosis_scope: Source public to actual native selector bases; unique same-direction crossings within fixed quarter-period window, with every missing/extra crossing retained. Diagnostic delays only, no phase fitting or altered original bit/device decisions.
